course_info.faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

catalog_course_description: Introduction to painting, sculpture and to basic notions of art making. Studio research into the numerous possibilities of various styles and approaches to visual art.
course_learning_outcomes: Learning basic concepts of perspective and drawing techniques.
Measuring and scaling real and virtual space.
course_objective: Sharpen observational skills to depict spatial and tonal relationships.
Master basic painting techniques, including the use of line, value, and color.
Translate two-dimensional drawings into three-dimensional sculptural forms.
Document sculptural work through photography for presentation purposes.

resources: Utility knife and safe cutting tools
Digital camera or smartphone for documentation

program_requirements.program: Visual Arts and Visual Communications Design
